baseline_models.focus_anchor: The intensive plural agent noun, the locative phrase fi al-uqad, and the explicit evil frame join mouth action to binding sites.
baseline_models.mechanism: Repeated light breath carrying slight moisture is directed into physical knots that localize and retain a hostile spell-binding operation.

activation_trace.role: The evil-and-badness image supplies the evaluative harm whose operating mechanism the other focus branches specify.
The light mouth-blow with slight spittle supplies a small repeated carrier and its directed delivery.
Fastening ends into a knot supplies the physical receiving sites that can hold the delivered action.
The magic-knot and spell image makes ritual binding an explicit packet-backed realization of those sites.

changed_reading.before: A generic request for protection from people performing an occult act.
changed_reading.after: A request against a staged delivery system in which minute repeated emissions are placed into prepared binding points so that harm persists.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The slight emission encoded by al-naffathat is placed inside or at al-uqad rather than applied as an overt blow.
baseline_models.mechanism: A minimal wet breath acts at a high-leverage fastening point; knotting and hardening preserve the input and amplify it into durable constraint.

activation_trace.role: The slight mouth-blow supplies the low-mass input whose smallness is central to the mechanism.
The tied junction supplies a leverage point where a small intervention can alter a larger connected structure.
The thickening-and-hardening image supplies persistence, turning a transient input into a set condition.
The badness image marks this amplification of a small input into lasting constraint as the protected-against harm.

changed_reading.before: The danger is proportional to an attacker's visible force.
changed_reading.after: The danger can be a tiny, repeated input placed at a structural junction where fastening or hardening gives it disproportionate durability.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus joins a form of venting to knots that can denote fixed conviction, tangled speech, and contracted anger.
baseline_models.mechanism: Pressure carried in a burdened chest is vented into already fixed or tangled structures, where it can settle as obscure speech, hardened belief, or prepared hostility.

activation_trace.role: The chest-burdened person's need to give vent supplies affective pressure and its outward release.
Fixed conviction and attachment supply durable cognitive or relational structures that can receive the vented pressure.
The tangled-speech image supplies a verbal structure in which released pressure can become obscurity rather than clarification.
Knotted anger supplies the hostile affective state that the venting may consolidate or ready for action.
The evil image assigns harmful valence to venting that loads and fixes hostility rather than releasing it harmlessly.

changed_reading.before: The focus refers only to a material breath applied to literal cords.
changed_reading.after: It can also model affective discharge entering tangled discourse or fixed convictions and making hostility harder to release.

context_deltas.mechanism: The commanded utterance initiates refuge under an agent of repair and completion, while opening or splitting supplies a counter-motion to the focus's breath-driven fastening.

activation_trace.role: Voiced utterance supplies an enacted oral counter-signal rather than silent awareness.
Seeking refuge supplies the protective relocation or alignment initiated by that utterance.
Repair, nurture, and completion supply the restorative capacity attributed to the refuge relation.
Splitting and opening supply the inverse spatial operation to fastening and closure.
The slight mouth-blow supplies the hostile oral operation to which voiced refuge is compared.
Spell-binding knots supply the closed hostile structure that the opening-and-repair sequence may counter.

structural_cues: 113:1 orders an utterance before the dangers are named, so protection is performed as well as requested.
Opening in al-falaq and fastening in al-uqad form a reversible spatial contrast across the context and focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies voiced saying, refuge, repair, opening, mouth-blowing, and spell-knots; I supply the arrow that the first sequence counter-operates on the second. A live alternative is that 113:1 only frames dependence and does not describe an unbinding operation.

changed_reading.before: Protection is a general petition external to the mechanics of the threat.
changed_reading.after: The petition itself becomes an enacted counter-operation: voiced refuge aligns with repair and opening against a breath that fastens and closes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context distinguishes two kinds of durable attachment: hostile fixation within knots and protective adherence within a sustaining shelter.

activation_trace.role: Sticking and remaining within a protecting ambit supplies a beneficial form of attachment.
Abiding and continuance give the protective attachment duration rather than momentary escape.
Fixed conviction and attachment supply the focus-side analogue whose value depends on what holds it.
The evil image marks one attachment as harmful without making attachment itself intrinsically harmful.

structural_cues: Both refuge and knotting organize a relation of being held, but the governing relations differ.
The repeated min sharr frame evaluates a configuration rather than every instance of firmness or attachment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies protective adherence, duration, fixed attachment, and evil; I infer that the context contrasts good and bad holding relations. The alternative is that refuge and knotting are unrelated images with no intended structural opposition.

changed_reading.after: Safety may instead mean leaving a hostile fixation for a durable protective attachment; the issue is what holds and governs the bond.

context_deltas.mechanism: The non-dominant split mapping from the command activates smallness, converging with the slight-spittle branch so that a minute input can set or harden a knot.

activation_trace.role: The split-mapped smallness image supplies a branch-distant cue that scale, not loudness, may be decisive.
A light blow with only a little spittle supplies the packet's direct image of a minute delivered quantity.
Hardening supplies the state change through which the minute delivery can become persistent.

structural_cues: The activating cue is a non-dominant split-root branch and therefore does not replace the surface command's ordinary sense.
The focus places the emission in a receiving structure, making a low-volume trigger mechanically conceivable.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a split-mapped smallness image, a slight wet breath, and hardening; I infer a tiny-trigger-to-durable-state arrow. The live alternative is that the split branch is accidental resonance and contributes nothing to the focus.

changed_reading.before: The harmful operation must announce itself through conspicuous force.
changed_reading.after: Its efficacy may lie precisely in a nearly negligible repeated dose that enters a prepared structure and sets there.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured formation and readiness recast the focus as a configured apparatus: a prepared junction remains latent until a slight input is delivered and hardened within it.

activation_trace.role: Measuring and proportioning supply deliberate configuration rather than an undifferentiated created object.
Aptitude and readiness supply a latent state in which the arrangement is prepared for activation.
The slight mouth-blow supplies the activating input delivered to the prepared arrangement.
The fastening point supplies the apparatus's localized receiving junction.
Hardening supplies the state transition that locks the input into the configured junction.

structural_cues: The general created domain in 113:2 precedes the specific agent-action-location configuration in 113:4.
The preposition fi places the active input within a prepared receiving structure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measuring, readiness, a slight delivered input, fastening, and hardening; I infer an apparatus-like sequence of preparation, activation, and locking. The alternative is a simple list of unrelated dangers with no engineered sequence.

changed_reading.before: The focus names an irrational threat whose efficacy is left wholly opaque.
changed_reading.after: It depicts a latent configured system: preparation and placement make a tiny trigger effective, after which the structure preserves the change.

context_deltas.mechanism: Fabricated speech is voiced or allowed to circulate, venting inward pressure into discourse until obscurity hardens into a fixed conviction.

activation_trace.role: Speech spreading among people supplies the transmission channel beyond a single mouth.
Fabricating false speech supplies the manufactured verbal content entering that channel.
Giving vent from a burdened chest supplies the affective pressure that drives the fabricated speech outward.
Tangled and obscure speech supplies the immediate result of circulated fabrication.
Fixed conviction supplies the durable cognitive endpoint after verbal tangling.

structural_cues: The context begins with commanded speech, while the focus contains a mouth-emission agent and a speech-entanglement branch.
113:2 broadens harm to what is formed, allowing fabricated verbal content to stand beside materially formed things.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies circulating speech, fabrication of false speech, chest-venting, tangled speech, and fixed conviction; I supply the transmission-and-hardening order. A live alternative is that these are separate branch analogies and the focus remains exclusively ritual.

changed_reading.before: The knots are only cords manipulated in a private rite.
changed_reading.after: They can also be knots of discourse and conviction produced when burdened, fabricated speech circulates and becomes cognitively fixed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Darkness entering and an object disappearing into a recess activate an ingress model: the slight payload passes into an enclosed knot, becomes hidden there, and operates after entry.

activation_trace.role: The entering darkness supplies a surrounding condition that advances by ingress rather than impact.
Entry into a recess until disappearance supplies concealment after penetration.
The slight wet breath supplies the payload capable of passing into a small receiving site.
Enclosure around a place supplies the closed interior in which an entered payload can be retained and hidden.

structural_cues: The conditional sequence idha waqab immediately precedes the focus and foregrounds the moment a danger enters.
The focus's fi al-uqad can be read strongly as interior placement rather than mere proximity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies entering darkness, disappearance in a recess, slight emission, and enclosure; I infer that the emission is a payload whose concealment permits delayed operation. The alternative is that 113:3 and 113:4 name independent dangers with no shared ingress logic.

changed_reading.before: The harmful breath acts visibly on the outside of a knot.
changed_reading.after: The decisive moment is concealed penetration: a small payload enters an enclosure, disappears within it, and only then becomes operative.

context_deltas.mechanism: A flowing discharge enters a hidden channel and thickens there, producing an occlusive material reading centered on arteries, wound-output, and congealed constrictions.

activation_trace.role: Flowing and pouring supply the mobile fluid phase of the mechanism.
Entry into a hidden recess supplies movement from open flow into a concealed channel.
The non-dominant artery image supplies a bodily conduit in which the entered flow can become dangerous.
A wound sending blood outward supplies the bodily discharge linked to the flow.
Thickening and hardening supply congealment and the resulting constriction.

structural_cues: 113:3 supplies a flow-to-entry sequence, while 113:4 supplies emission, interior placement, and a hardening branch.
The focus permits simultaneous outward discharge from a wound and inward lodging within a constricted site.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies flow, hidden entry, an artery branch, blood-output, and thickening; I infer a vascular flow-to-congealment arrow. A live alternative is that this is only a cross-domain material analogy with no bodily referent in the ayah.

changed_reading.before: The focus's material action is limited to breath, saliva, and cord.
changed_reading.after: It can carry an exploratory fluid-system model in which discharge enters a bodily conduit and hardens into a dangerous occlusion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The contrast between destructive envy and non-removing admiration, together with the agent-plus-enactment sequence, localizes evil in an operation brought into effect rather than in an undifferentiated class of persons.

activation_trace.role: Wishing a blessing removed supplies the destructive intention that becomes harmful when enacted.
Admiration without removing the blessing supplies a nearby non-destructive alternative and prevents flattening all intense regard into evil.
The agent's repeated mouth-action supplies the focus-side enactment to which the envy distinction is extended.
The evil image evaluates the enacted harmful configuration rather than independently defining every agent named by the noun.

structural_cues: 113:5 repeats the root in an agent noun and a verb under idha, marking the transition from capacity or identity to enactment.
113:4 and 113:5 share the min sharr plus agent frame, inviting the later conditional clause to sharpen how agency is evaluated.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies destructive and non-destructive envy branches, an agent-action condition, repeated blowing, and evil; I extend the enactment distinction across the parallel clauses. The alternative is that 113:4 identifies a fixed agent class without the conditional qualification found in 113:5.

changed_reading.before: The grammatical class named by al-naffathat is itself treated as intrinsically evil.
changed_reading.after: The evil is more precisely the harmful operation when performed and directed into bindings, leaving room to distinguish agency, capacity, and enactment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Destructive envy motivates fabricated talk; burdened speech then circulates through a community and loads covenants or attachments until bonds weaken or hostile convictions harden.

activation_trace.role: Speech spreading among people supplies the social propagation channel.
Fabricated false speech supplies intentionally shaped harmful content.
The wish that another's blessing disappear supplies a motive for deploying the fabricated content.
Chest-burdened venting supplies the affective force with which the content is released.
Ratified obligations and covenants supply social bonds vulnerable to corrosive speech.
Fixed attachment and conviction supply both relational targets and the possible hardened hostile result.

structural_cues: The surah moves from commanded speech through created harm to a mouth-action focus and then to an explicitly destructive social motive.
The plural agent in 113:4 permits a distributed process, while the bond branches of al-uqad permit social as well as physical attachment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies circulating speech, fabricated talk, destructive envy, venting, covenants, and fixed attachments; I supply the motive-to-propagation-to-bond-damage sequence. A live alternative is that envy and the focus operation are parallel dangers rather than stages of one social mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The focus describes a secluded rite with no ordinary social pathway.
changed_reading.after: It can also describe envious, manufactured talk propagated into a network of obligations and attachments, where it corrodes bonds or fixes hostility.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from ritual action into an atmospheric material system and combines both mapped targets of the split sharr root. It remains focus-anchored through sparks or flashes, a breath-like propulsion, and gathered cloud-knots. Downstream prose should present it only as a branch-induced material analogy, not as a claim that the focus nouns lexically denote a storm.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus can align flying sparks or spreading flashes with a light expulsive motion occurring in gathered cloud formations.

activation_trace.role: Flying fire-sparks supply hazardous particles dispersed from a source.
The non-dominant spreading-lightning image supplies repeated flashes across a larger medium.
The light blow supplies breath-like propulsion for dispersal without requiring a heavy impact.
Gathered and contracted cloud supplies the knotted atmospheric medium through which flashes or sparks spread.

changed_reading.before: The focus's imagery is confined to a human ritual over cord.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory material analogy, it can model breath-driven hazardous sparks or flashes moving through contracted cloud-knots.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the exchange image comes from the non-dominant sharr mapping and turns spell-binding into a transactional speech-act. It remains anchored by the focus's breath and obligation-knot, with contextual negotiation and covenant branches reinforcing the structure. Render it as an analogy for coercive commitment, not as a lexical equation of evil with commerce.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus places an oral act into knots that can bind obligations, while the split sharr inventory can activate exchange.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant buying-and-selling exchange image supplies a transfer with reciprocal stakes.
The mouth-blow supplies the compact performative act by which the imagined transfer is effected.
Binding and ratifying an obligation supply the durable contractual result.
Negotiating an affair supplies a contextual speech-act setting for obligation.
The covenant image supplies a second contextual form of socially binding commitment.

changed_reading.before: Spell-binding is an opaque manipulation with no social analogue.
changed_reading.after: It can be carried as an exploratory image of a coercive oral transaction that seals another into an obligation or unequal exchange.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the venting branch can describe release rather than attack, reversing the expected valence of the mouth-action. It remains anchored by venting, knotted anger or conviction, and the explicit evil frame. Downstream prose should qualify the source-to-target transfer as reader inference: the same discharge may relieve the source while harmfully loading another structure.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus grammatically marks evil from the venting agents in relation to knots, leaving the direction and recipient of released pressure open to reconstruction.

activation_trace.role: The burdened chest giving vent supplies a release that may benefit its source even while exporting pressure.
Knotted anger supplies a hostile receiving state that exported pressure may tighten or activate.
Fixed conviction and attachment supply additional structures that can be loaded by the discharge.
The evil image locates harmful valence in the transfer configuration rather than necessarily in release itself.

changed_reading.before: Any venting or blowing named by the agent noun is intrinsically harmful.
changed_reading.after: The harm may be directional: pressure released from one chest becomes evil when deposited into and used to tighten another's anger, attachment, or conviction.

strongest_changes: The opening command turns voiced refuge, repair, and splitting into a plausible counter-operation to breath-driven fastening.
The created-form branches expose a preparation-to-trigger-to-hardening mechanism and also open a social-cognitive path through fabricated speech.
The darkness and entry sequence shifts attention from visible attack to concealed ingress, with an exploratory flow-to-occlusion reading remaining live.
The envy contrast relocates evil from an undifferentiated agent class to destructive intention when enacted, while also supplying a motive for social bond corrosion.
summary.what_was_special: The focus inventories support unusually tight mouth-to-knot mechanisms across ritual, structural, affective, verbal, and material domains. Split-root branches add live but containable readings involving smallness, arteries, lightning, and exchange instead of being suppressed.
remaining_uncertainties: The opening-and-repair sequence may merely contrast with knotting rather than causally undo it.
The split-root activations may be productive latent resonances or only mapping-distance artifacts.
The preposition fi may mark location in the knots, action upon them, or directed placement into them; several mechanisms depend on the strongest interior reading.
The feminine intensive plural may identify literal female agents, a grammatically marked class, or recurrent forces; the packet does not settle that scope.
The vascular, atmospheric, and transactional readings are coherent branch mosaics but may remain analogical rather than referential.
